CAGED is used here as an indexing system, not a shape religion. Each form identifies a root region, a practical chord fragment, nearby triad inversions, a chord-tone arpeggio, and
surrounding scale tones. Full C and G forms are optional; partial voicings and triads are the primary performance material.

Boundary and session protocol
Form the root map silently. Sound the practical fragment. Identify one triad inversion. Arpeggiate the chord tones. Add nearby scale tones and return to the chord. Do not force the full G form or a full
movable C form when a partial voicing is cleaner and more musical.
SUCCESS The player can move from a root to a useful chord, triad, arpeggio, and scale phrase without searching the entire neck.
